bash: Run a shell command. Use for build, test, git; not for reading files. workdir sets the directory; timeout in ms.
edit: Replace exact, unique text in a file (oldString → newString). Read the file first.
glob: Find files by glob pattern. path limits the directory.
grep: Regex search in file contents. include filters files by glob; path limits the directory.
question: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer.
read: Read a file (absolute filePath) as numbered lines; offset and limit page large files.
skill: Load a listed skill's instructions by name.
task: Run a sub-agent (subagent_type) on a self-contained prompt; returns its result.
todowrite: Replace the todo list (content, status, priority).
tool_search: Find MCP tools by keyword; matches become callable next turn.
webfetch: Fetch a URL as markdown, text or html.
write: Create or overwrite a file (absolute filePath) with content.
